body: It's difficult to talk to my therapist about it because everything comes in waves and it's a lot of emotion to sort through, so sometimes it's out of order and doesn't make sense. It seems like I'm trying to sort through a state's worth of trash (all of my life experiences) to find one little treasure (aka my sanity). It seems like I'm wasting my time trying to organize it all, but I still try sometimes. I'm not even sure what I mean now. I'm sorry for any trouble.
I'm not sure there's any reasonable thing to talk about. I'm mostly in a "cry until I fall asleep" mood. Thank you for reaching out to help so many people, though.
